request   GET https://api.example.com/v1/items
actor     research/agent
decision  allow
reason    route: a route matched the method and path
policy    api-readonly
template  /v1/**
logged    at INFO: a claiming policy has logAllowed

Policies claiming api.example.com for research/agent:
  api-readonly  Enforce, logAllowed  alone: allow (route, /v1/**)
  files-audit   Audit                alone: audit (no_route)

An Enforce policy claims the host, so the Audit policies' routes are not consulted.
